deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min; feed solution prepared and transferred to sealed reservoir under argon headspace; argon blanket maintained on reservoir during pumping; Stage 1 tubing purged with degassed solvent before run. No inline degasser used (hard constraint).
pre_reactor_steps: Offline argon sparging of EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min to remove dissolved O2 (Chemistry Plan deoxygenation_reasoning; hard constraint: no inline degasser available)

Dissolve PMPSCH2TMS (1a, 0.1 M), acrylonitrile (2a, 0.2 M), and Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)2(dtbpy)PF6 (0.5 mol%) in pre-degassed solvent; transfer to sealed feed reservoir under argon headspace (Chemistry Plan stream_logic Stream A)
Purge all Stage 1 tubing and reactor coil with degassed solvent under argon before starting the run to displace any residual O2 (Chemistry Plan deoxygenation_reasoning)

Verify BPR set to 3.0 bar before starting flow to maintain acrylonitrile (bp 77 °C) in solution and prevent uncontrolled degassing in Stage 2 gas-liquid system (Engineering Step 8: BPR required 5.9 bar — constrained to 3.0 bar max available; monitor for acrylonitrile evaporation)

stage_2_air_streams.pump_role: Air MFC gas feed injected at interstage T-mixer between Stage 1 and Stage 2 coils
contents: Air (O2 ~21%, ~1.5 equiv O2 relative to sulfide 3a)
stage_2_air_streams.reasoning: Deterministic gas stoichiometry: inlet/STP MFC flow was recomputed from target gas equivalents (1.00 equiv), liquid flow 0.04283 mL/min, and substrate concentration. Pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow is reported separately; supplied gas equiv = 1.00.
